integrity: The proof uses the primary source extremizer only after verifying that all of its roots are nonsingular and recording its orientation split. The identity F=p conjugate(H) reverses the orientation counts exactly. The real-analytic implicit-function theorem then continues all roots under arbitrary coefficient perturbations, and the independently checked global 3n-1 upper bound excludes extra roots. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is local in the full coefficient space for degree-n p and linear q. It gives no quantitative neighborhood radius, does not classify the global extremal locus or its boundary, and does not address higher-degree q.
title: Coefficient-robust maximal valence for logharmonic polynomials
